newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF, BOJ chat for an hour but don't discuss rates.
newsitem.headline: MOF, BOJ chat for an hour but don't discuss rates.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka and Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita met for an hour on Friday but did not discuss interest rates, Mitsuzuka told reporters.
Asked whether he discussed the issue of interest rates with Matsushita, he said: "No I did not."
Mitsuzuka was speaking after a visit to the central bank to see its daily operations at firsthand. The visit had no policy implications, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) had said earlier.
